The source and test code that implements this behavior is not in the supplied batch, so only the documentation change was examined. The change is a documentation-only, security-neutral edit as written. It touches no attestation, App Attest, encryption, authorization, billing or availability logic, and does not alter any TB-002/TB-009/TB-011 or T-0xx assumption. The changelog entry makes no claim about security boundaries.

The next pass should confirm, if the implementing code appears elsewhere, that the retired global key cannot silently select `typical`, that the fallback to `exact` is fail-safe, and that the telemetry value is not treated as trust evidence. I have no basis to report any of these as issues from this diff alone.
